figure: dues.party.balance (what one customer owes: the counter's per-customer balance and open bills)
covers: The counter snapshot (routes/till.js) carries each customer's balance and open bills; the SQL (receivableBills) and the fold (foldByParty) live in books-dues.js beside the dues list. tests/one-figure-dues.test.cjs proves the party balance equals the dues engine's per-party outstanding on the same rows, and goes red when the receivable-only rule or the sum is changed.
The old name foldDues (the till's own fold) may not come back.
decided: 2026-11-28 drift exit RC10. A balance is the SUM of the party's receivable items; netting a receipt on account moves money between a party's bills, never between parties, so the counter's balance and the list's balance are one number.
